corpus_name: World Bank - Taking Stock: An Update on Vietnam's Recent Economic Developments (2 editions)
page_counting_rule: A page counts as content when it carries report prose relevant to the topic (overview, Part I, Part II/special focus, including figure/table pages that sit inside these sections). Excluded: cover, blank page, title page, acknowledgements, acronyms, table of contents / lists of figures-tables-boxes, part divider pages with only a title, and references. Physical PDF page numbers are used (they coincide with the printed page numbers in both reports). Per-page character counts after normalization are generated by `python -m src.run ingest` into data/page_inventory.csv.
